title: QUIC and HTTP/3 System.Diagnostics.Metrics surface work item
summary: Add the first standard Meter-based QUIC and HTTP/3 diagnostic instrument surface without changing protocol behavior or qlog boundaries.
planned_changes:
- Add internal QUIC and HTTP/3 Meter helpers with stable meter names and the requested instrument names.
- Wire connection, stream, socket datagram, blocked, PTO, RTT, and HTTP/3 request observations without changing protocol behavior.
- Keep tags bounded and exclude connection IDs, stream IDs, endpoints, peer addresses, URL paths, exception messages, and raw errors.
- Document the metric names, meanings, and tag contract.
- Add focused MeterListener tests and a BenchmarkDotNet disabled-listener benchmark for the socket datagram metric path.
verification_plan: Run focused metrics tests, focused HTTP/3 diagnostics tests, the QUIC test project, dotnet build, a focused BenchmarkDotNet disabled-listener check, SpecTrace validation, and git diff whitespace checks.
completion_notes: Implemented the first internal System.Diagnostics.Metrics surface for QUIC and HTTP/3. The transport core remains qlog-free and metrics do not depend on diagnostics sinks. Socket datagram and byte paths use Instrument.Enabled gates before tag construction; HTTP/3 request metrics classify status and failure by bounded values only.
